about_the_game:
ESCAPE FROM CRIMSON MANOR: TRAPPED TOGETHER

Two Minds, One Escape. The Ultimate Co-op Puzzle Experience.

Escape from Crimson Manor: Trapped Together is first and foremost a test of communication and deduction. Set in a sprawling, interconnected Victorian mansion, this game brings the intricate puzzle design of The Inheritance of Crimson Manor into a dedicated two-player experience.

🗝️ THE MAIN EVENT: Co-op Puzzle Campaign (2 Players) "Trapped Together"

Designed for those who value logic over panic. In this full narrative campaign, you cannot die. There is no monster chasing you—only the mansion itself stands in your way.

  • Separated but Connected: Wake up in opposite wings of the mansion. You cannot see what your partner sees; voice communication is your only tool.

  • Pure Deduction: Without the threat of death, take your time to solve complex mechanical puzzles and decipher cryptic riddles in a stress-free environment.

  • Exchange Mechanics: One player has the recipe, the other has the ingredients. Master the dumbwaiter system to trade tools, keys, and crucial clues between floors to progress together.

🩸 BONUS MODE: Asymmetric Survival (3v1) "The Blood Harvest" [NOT AVAILABLE IN DEMO]

Looking for adrenaline after the puzzles? Switch gears in this high-stakes replayable mode where survival is not guaranteed.

  • The Alchemist vs. Survivors: One player becomes the obsessed Alchemist, hunting up to three Survivors.

  • The Hunt: Unlike the main campaign, here death is real. The Alchemist uses the dumbwaiters to ambush victims and drain their essence to become younger and faster.

  • The Escape: Survivors must use stealth and sabotage to locate blood vials and break the lockdown before they are bled dry.

KEY FEATURES

  • Two Distinct Experiences: A pure brain-teasing Co-op Campaign and a heart-pounding Asymmetric Horror mode included in one package.

  • Dynamic Mansion: 2 Floors, 2 Wings, and a Central Hub interconnected by a web of tunnels.

  • Gothic Atmosphere: An immersive Victorian setting expanded with enhanced visuals and new dark zones.

  • The Anemia System (PvP Only): In the Blood Harvest mode, health is a resource. Losing blood blurs vision and slows movement—manage your vitality to survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 Sp1
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4460, 2.70GHz or AMD FX™-6300 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound

short_description: Work together to escape the manor in "Trapped Together", a narrative co-op puzzle campaign where logic reigns and death is not an option. Communicate, trade items via dumbwaiter, and solve intricate riddles. Also features "The Blood Harvest", a bonus 3v1 asymmetric horror mode.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America
